raw_response: {"summary":"The manifest reveals 6 exported components (activities, a service, a receiver and a content provider) all without protection permissions, in addition to debuggable mode and allowBackup enabled – exposing the app to a broad attack surface.","attack_surface":["SplashActivity","AccessControl1ViewActivity","DownloadInvoiceService","ShowDataReceiver","ContentProviderActivity"],"top_risks":["exported components with no protecting permission","application debuggable=true","allowBackup=true","use of dangerous permissions (CAMERA, WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, USE_BIOMETRIC, USE_FINGERPRINT)","unprotected content provider exposed to all apps"],"abuse_hypotheses":["A malicious app can start SplashActivity via intent, leading to arbitrary code execution or information disclosure; invoke AccessControl1ViewActivity to trigger unintended behaviors; bind to DownloadInvoiceService to read/write internal data; broadcast to ShowDataReceiver to trigger hidden functions; read/write userpins data through the exported content provider; exploit camera and external storage permissions to exfiltrate data.","By enabling debuggable and allowBackup, attackers can attach a debugger or restore data trojan.","The presence of PROFILEINSTALLRECEIVER may allow privileged broadcasts if an attacker gains DUMP permission.","Using network_security_config without restrictions may allow cleartext traffic abuse."],"recommended_next_steps":["Remove debuggable flag from release builds (android:debuggable=\"false\").","Set android:allowBackup=\"false\" or store sensitive data in internal storage only.","Add protecting permissions (e.g., android:permission=\"android.permission.INTERNET\" or custom) to all exported components or mark them as non-exported.","Restrict or remove the exported content provider, or enforce permissions on it.","Review and tighten the usage of CAMERA, WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, USE_BIOMETRIC, and USE_FINGERPRINT permissions, ensuring they are needed and properly scoped."}
